overview_description.description: Coco Wallet provides a mobile wallet for sending, receiving, and managing digital dollars. The service supports stablecoins including USDC and USDT, allowing users to hold and save digital funds. It supports local and international transfers, a virtual account connected to the United States or Europe, and mobile payments in Venezuela. The service is available through mobile applications.
